meta.title: The First 90 Days
meta.subtitle: Scenario 80 — Two Tracks, One Family (a fictional composite)
meta.summary: Concurrent planning in the open: the agency builds an adoption track beside the reunification track, and the father's record is what keeps one goal from quietly replacing the other.

nodes.title: The Clock You Cannot See
body: Your name is Gideon. Your child Emrys, 11, has been in foster care since the date the court set — and a second calendar started that day, one nobody handed you a copy of.

Fifteen of the most recent twenty-two months. That is the federal permanency clock (42 U.S.C. § 675(5)(E)), and this story is the fifteen months, played honestly: a goal-change motion filed while his services were still running. Emrys, eleven, has started asking the visit supervisor to write down that he asked about home.

addHidden: Dated documentation added to the case record
choices.note: Another dated page joins the folder.

choices.text: Handle it with a conversation and move on
choices.note: Conversations end. The file keeps what it was given.

nodes.title: The Lawyer Draws the Clock
body: Your lawyer draws one line: Emrys's months in care, counted from the entry date. At month fifteen the agency's duty about filing a termination petition changes — unless an exception is documented.

She underlines one word three times: documented. Progress the file cannot show is, to the clock, progress that did not happen. Counsel is yours in this process (42 Pa.C.S. § 6337) — use the appointments like court dates.

choices.text: Do the paper version: dated, copied, filed
addHidden: Dated documentation added to the case record
choices.note: Another dated page joins the folder.

choices.text: Handle it with a conversation and move on
choices.note: Conversations end. The file keeps what it was given.

nodes.title: The Record Request
body: The agency file holds the ratings, the referral log, and the plan as the agency wrote it. Records in that file are to be released on request (55 Pa. Code § 3130.44(d)).
Requesting it costs a stamp and a week of waiting. Not requesting it means arguing the fifteenth month from memory against people reading from paper.

choices.text: Send the written request for the complete case record this week
addHidden: Case record requested in writing under § 3130.44(d)
choices.note: The request is dated. Reconnaissance has a postmark.

choices.text: Ask the worker to just tell you what the file says
choices.note: She summarizes kindly. A summary is not a record, and next month it will not be in your folder.

nodes.title: The Folder
body: Your folder holds what your life can prove: pay stubs, certificates, sign-in sheets, and Emrys's drawings in the back, because folders are also archives.
The question this month is not whether you worked. It is whether the work exists anywhere outside your kitchen table.

choices.text: Do the paper version: dated, copied, filed
addHidden: Dated documentation added to the case record
choices.note: Another dated page joins the folder.

choices.text: Handle it with a conversation and move on
choices.note: Conversations end. The file keeps what it was given.

nodes.title: A Visit, Counted
body: The visit goes well. Emrys leaves with the practiced wave of a child who has learned the choreography of goodbye.
What the log will say is a separate event from what the visit was. Logs are written by people with pens, and pens can be asked, in writing, to write more.

choices.text: Ask, in writing, for the visit log to note what actually happened
addHidden: Visit log corrected/completed at the parent's written request
choices.note: The log now shows a visit and a parent who writes things down.

choices.text: Let the log stand as written
choices.note: The blank stays blank. Blanks get read as absence.

nodes.title: The Service That Is a Box
body: On the plan, one line matters most: the coached-visit program. Beside it, a box. The state of that box — sent, started, completed, empty — is a fact about the agency as much as about you.
Boxes do not fill themselves, and they do not testify. Dates do.

choices.text: Ask for the referral's dates in writing — promised, sent, started
addHidden: Referral chronology requested in writing
choices.note: Three dates, requested politely. One of them does not exist, and now that is written down too.

choices.text: Trust that the referral is moving somewhere
choices.note: Somewhere is not a date.

nodes.title: Paper With a Date On It
body: A letter can do what a phone call cannot: exist in two months at once. One copy for the agency, one for the folder, one for the lawyer.
What needs dating this month is a goal-change motion filed while his services were still running — said by the person who administers it, on paper, with a date.

choices.text: Get it in a dated letter, on letterhead, and file your copy
addHidden: Key barrier documented by a dated letter
choices.note: A rumor becomes a fact with a date on it.

choices.text: Accept the verbal estimate — the number sounded right
choices.note: Around, approximately, roughly. The file will keep the adverbs and lose the number.

nodes.title: The Family Name in the Minutes
body: A relative has been named at two reviews; the name lives in the minutes and nowhere else.
Kinship is the first exception the statute names — but a name spoken at a review is not a placement, a study, or a fact. It has to be built like everything else: in writing, early.

choices.text: Put the kinship request in writing and ask for the study to be ordered
addHidden: Kinship placement requested in writing; study asked for
choices.note: A name in the minutes becomes a request with a date.

choices.text: Let the family offer ride on the meeting's goodwill
choices.note: Goodwill is real. It is also not a study.

nodes.title: The Shift and the Hearing
body: Work does not pause for permanency. Your supervisor has learned the shape of your court dates the way she learned the holiday schedule.
Every accommodation you need exists twice: once as a favor, once as a signed schedule. Only one of those survives a supervisor change.

choices.text: Do the paper version: dated, copied, filed
addHidden: Dated documentation added to the case record
choices.note: Another dated page joins the folder.

choices.text: Handle it with a conversation and move on
choices.note: Conversations end. The file keeps what it was given.

nodes.title: The School Note
body: Emrys's teacher sends home proof of an ordinary life continuing — grades, a comment, a drawing with too many suns.
File it. At month fifteen, ordinary life, documented, is evidence that the story the petition tells is not the only story in the room.

nodes.title: Getting There
body: The bus, the transfer, the visit room across town: logistics are the tax this system charges in hours instead of dollars.
Every arrival you can prove is a rebuttal to the only narrative the clock carries — that time passed and nothing changed.

choices.text: Do the paper version: dated, copied, filed
addHidden: Dated documentation added to the case record
choices.note: Another dated page joins the folder.

choices.text: Handle it with a conversation and move on
choices.note: Conversations end. The file keeps what it was given.

nodes.title: The Call You Make in Writing
body: Some calls should be emails. Some emails should be letters. The medium is the evidence.
Ms. Karp is not unkind. Ms. Karp is carrying forty cases. What survives a caseload is what was written to it.

choices.text: Do the paper version: dated, copied, filed
addHidden: Dated documentation added to the case record
choices.note: Another dated page joins the folder.

choices.text: Handle it with a conversation and move on
choices.note: Conversations end. The file keeps what it was given.

nodes.title: The List
body: The list that governs a goal-change motion filed while his services were still running moves at the speed of other people's housing, other people's luck.
A position on a list, stated verbally, is a rumor. The same position in a dated letter is a fact a court can hold.

choices.text: Get it in a dated letter, on letterhead, and file your copy
addHidden: Key barrier documented by a dated letter
choices.note: A rumor becomes a fact with a date on it.

choices.text: Accept the verbal estimate — the number sounded right
choices.note: Around, approximately, roughly. The file will keep the adverbs and lose the number.

nodes.title: The Home Half-Ready
body: You prepare a home for a child who does not live in it yet, in the order the inspections will ask about.
Hope is not a housing plan, but a lease, a letter, and a dated application are the skeleton of one.

addHidden: Dated documentation added to the case record
choices.note: Another dated page joins the folder.

choices.text: Handle it with a conversation and move on
choices.note: Conversations end. The file keeps what it was given.

nodes.title: The Wider Family
body: The case is about one child on paper and a whole family in fact. Siblings, grandparents, the people who show up — the file flattens them into "supports."
Supports that exist in writing get weighed. Supports that exist at Thanksgiving get mentioned. There is a difference, and month fifteen knows it.

choices.text: Do the paper version: dated, copied, filed
addHidden: Dated documentation added to the case record
choices.note: Another dated page joins the folder.

choices.text: Handle it with a conversation and move on
choices.note: Conversations end. The file keeps what it was given.

nodes.title: The Second Letter
body: The first letter started a paper trail. The second one proves the trail is a practice, not an accident.
Agencies answer letters on agency time. Silence, dated, is also an answer — and it can be attached.

choices.text: Do the paper version: dated, copied, filed
addHidden: Dated documentation added to the case record
choices.note: Another dated page joins the folder.

choices.text: Handle it with a conversation and move on
choices.note: Conversations end. The file keeps what it was given.

nodes.title: A Visit, Noted
body: This visit, Emrys asks the question directly: when? The supervisor's note will record the visit. What it records about the answer is up to who writes first.
Ask for the note to be complete. A log that shows a question and a plan reads differently from a log that shows a blank.

addHidden: Visit log corrected/completed at the parent's written request
choices.note: The log now shows a visit and a parent who writes things down.

choices.text: Let the log stand as written
choices.note: The blank stays blank. Blanks get read as absence.

nodes.title: The Folder, Audited
body: Your lawyer spreads the folder on her desk like a hand of cards and tells you which ones the court can actually play.
Affection is not an exhibit. Certificates are exhibits. Letters are exhibits. The folder is only as strong as its dates.

choices.text: Do the paper version: dated, copied, filed
addHidden: Dated documentation added to the case record
choices.note: Another dated page joins the folder.

choices.text: Handle it with a conversation and move on
choices.note: Conversations end. The file keeps what it was given.

nodes.title: The Review Where the Date Is Said
body: This time the date is said aloud, in the room, on the record: the fifteenth month, and what the agency must do when it arrives unless an exception applies.
Hearing it said is the moment the case changes tense — from someday to scheduled.

choices.text: Ask what exception the agency intends to document, and ask on the record
addHidden: Agency asked on the record which exception it will document
choices.note: The question is now part of the case, not just part of the day.

choices.text: Contest the goal change out loud, at length, from the heart
choices.note: The heart is not the record. The goal question moves without your paper in it.

choices.text: Say nothing and save your energy for the hearing
choices.note: Silence conserves energy and spends leverage.

nodes.title: The Packet
body: The packet is the whole paper case in one stack: the record you requested, the letters, the log corrections, the dated proof — tabbed, copied, filed before the date it answers.
Filing it converts your fifteen months from a story you tell into a document the agency must reckon with.

choices.text: File the packet and ask for the finding in writing
addHidden: Exception packet filed before the fifteen-month date
choices.note: Filed, stamped, copied. The clock now has something to meet.

choices.text: Bring the packet to the hearing and hand it up there
choices.note: Paper delivered at the deadline is paper the other side has not read. Timing is part of evidence.

nodes.title: Rehearsing the Hearing
body: Your lawyer rehearses you the way lawyers do: short answers, dates first, no speeches.
"The judge has read the packet," she says. "Your job is to be the person the packet describes."

choices.text: Do the paper version: dated, copied, filed
addHidden: Dated documentation added to the case record
choices.note: Another dated page joins the folder.

choices.text: Handle it with a conversation and move on
choices.note: Conversations end. The file keeps what it was given.

nodes.title: The Night Before
body: The night before the review, the folder is closed and the clock is what it is.
Everything controllable has been controlled or it has not. What remains is to walk in with the record you built.

choices.text: Do the paper version: dated, copied, filed
addHidden: Dated documentation added to the case record
choices.note: Another dated page joins the folder.

choices.text: Handle it with a conversation and move on
choices.note: Conversations end. The file keeps what it was given.

nodes.title: The Morning Of
body: Court clothes on a chair. The packet in a bag by the door. A child, somewhere across town, eating breakfast in a house that is not this one.
Fifteen months comes down to a morning, the way every deadline does.

choices.text: Do the paper version: dated, copied, filed
addHidden: Dated documentation added to the case record
choices.note: Another dated page joins the folder.

choices.text: Handle it with a conversation and move on
choices.note: Conversations end. The file keeps what it was given.

nodes.title: The Compelling-Reason Track
body: The second exception: the agency documents in the case plan a compelling reason why filing would not be in the child's best interest (42 U.S.C. § 675(5)(E)). "Documented in the case plan" is a place and a page, not a feeling in a meeting.
Build the packet that gives the agency a reason it can write down: dated progress, dated barriers, dated proof.

choices.text: Build this track's record completely, in writing
addHidden: Exception track record completed and filed
choices.note: The exception is no longer an argument. It is a stack of dated facts.

choices.text: Argue the exception from the facts everyone already knows
choices.note: Known to you. The file is the room's memory, and it was not in the room.

nodes.kicker: Day 457 — Wednesday, August 5, 2026 — THE FIFTEEN-MONTH DATE: Wednesday, August 5, 2026
nodes.title: The Fifteen-Month Review
body: The review is held on the date the clock named: Wednesday, August 5, 2026 — fifteen months from Monday, May 5, 2025. The agency must file or join a termination petition unless an exception is documented (42 U.S.C. § 675(5)(E)).
What happens next was decided by paper filed before today. That was always the design of this clock — and of this story.

choices.text: Put the packet's dates to the court and ask for the exception to be documented
choices.note: The dates do the talking.

choices.text: Accept the documented deferral the agency offers at the table
choices.note: Not the best door — but a door with the exception's name on it.

choices.text: Give the speech about everything you have done
choices.note: It is a true speech. The petition is a document. Documents outlast speeches.

nodes.title: Ending — The Goal Stays Reunification
body: The exception is documented — written into the case plan, dated, on the record. The petition the clock pointed at is not filed. Emrys remains placed and the case continues toward its goal, but the fifteenth month met a record instead of a rumor.
Read the order twice. Then keep the folder. Cases like this one are not finished by endings; they are continued by them.
debrief: THE CLOCK, ANSWERED: entry Monday, May 5, 2025 + 15 months = Wednesday, August 5, 2026. At 15 of the most recent 22 months in foster care, the agency must file or join a petition to terminate parental rights — unless an exception applies (42 U.S.C. § 675(5)(E)). The three exceptions, as this scenario states them: the child is being cared for by a relative; the agency has documented a compelling reason in the case plan why filing would not be in the child's best interest; or the agency has not provided the services the plan identified as necessary for the child's safe return.

Agency records are released on request — 55 Pa. Code § 3130.44(d) ("shall be released upon request"). The record request is the reconnaissance that makes every later date arguable. A termination petition, if filed, is a separate case the agency must still prove by clear and convincing evidence. A filing date is not a finding, and this scenario ends at the filing decision — it depicts no termination outcome.

THE HONEST PART: the packet did not guarantee this. It guaranteed the agency and the court had to reckon with dated facts instead of impressions. Workers, judges, housing lists, and luck still decided their parts — your choices decided what paper they decided on.

nodes.title: Ending — Documented, and Waiting
body: The exception is documented and the filing is deferred — a real legal win with a child still placed at the end of it. The case continues, the goal survives, and the next review has a date too.
debrief: THE CLOCK, DEFERRED: at Wednesday, August 5, 2026 the agency documented an exception rather than filing (42 U.S.C. § 675(5)(E)). Deferral is not dismissal; it is time, in writing.

A termination petition, if filed, is a separate case the agency must still prove by clear and convincing evidence. A filing date is not a finding, and this scenario ends at the filing decision — it depicts no termination outcome.
THE HONEST PART: this ending is what the strongest controllable strategy usually buys — not the child home, but the petition unfilled and the record improved. It is labeled partial because it is one.

nodes.title: Ending — The Petition Is Filed
body: The petition is filed on the clock's schedule, from the file as it stood. Your effort was real. Too much of it was undated, unmailed, or unspoken in the rooms where the file was written.
debrief: THE CLOCK, UNANSWERED: at Wednesday, August 5, 2026 no exception stood documented, so the filing duty operated (42 U.S.C. § 675(5)(E)).

A termination petition, if filed, is a separate case the agency must still prove by clear and convincing evidence. A filing date is not a finding, and this scenario ends at the filing decision — it depicts no termination outcome. The case now changes forums and burdens — it does not end today.
THE HONEST PART: petitions are filed against parents who worked hard, when the work never became paper. That is the lesson this scenario exists to teach before it costs anyone anything real.
